commands.help:
zstack-cli is a command-line interface for managing ZStack resources.

Usage:
  zstack-cli [flags]
  zstack-cli [command]

Available Commands:
  backup-storage  Manage backup storage
  completion      Generate completion script
  config          Manage CLI configuration and contexts
  create          Create one or many resources
  delete          Delete one or many resources
  describe        Describe a resource
  doctor          Check selected configuration and API access without changing credentials
  eip             Manage EIPs
  expunge         Expunge one or many resources
  get             Display one or many resources
  global-config   Manage global configurations
  help            Help about any command
  host            Manage hosts
  image           Manage images and data volume templates
  image-group     Manage image groups
  instance        Manage VM instances
  job             Resume or clean long-running jobs
  l2-network      Manage L2 networks
  l3-network      Manage L3 networks
  load-balancer   Manage load balancer listeners
  login           Login to ZStack API server
  logout          Revoke the saved session and clear credentials for the selected context
  port-forwarding Manage port forwarding rules
  primary-storage Manage primary storage
  project         Manage the lifecycle of IAM2 projects
  security-group  Manage security groups
  snapshot        Manage volume snapshots
  update          Update resource metadata
  version         Show zstack-cli version
  vm-script       Manage VM scripts
  volume          Manage volumes
  wait            Wait for a resource to reach a state

To load completions:

Bash:
  source <(zstack-cli completion bash)

  # To load completions for each session, execute once:
  # Linux:
  zstack-cli completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/zstack-cli
  # macOS:
  zstack-cli completion bash > /usr/local/etc/bash_completion.d/zstack-cli

Zsh:
  # If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment,
  # you will need to enable it. You can execute once:
  echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit" >> ~/.zshrc

  # To load completions for each session, execute once:
  zstack-cli completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_zstack-cli"

Fish:
  zstack-cli completion fish | source
  zstack-cli completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/zstack-cli.fish

PowerShell:
  zstack-cli completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
  zstack-cli completion powershell > zstack-cli.ps1
  # and source this file from your PowerShell profile.

Create a new image in ZStack cloud platform.

Examples:
  # Create a basic image from URL
  zstack-cli create image my-image --url http://example.com/image.qcow2 --image-storage bs-uuid1

  # Create a Windows image with more options
  zstack-cli create image windows-image --url http://example.com/windows.qcow2 --image-storage bs-uuid1 \
    --media-type RootVolumeTemplate --format qcow2 --platform Windows --guest-os-type "Windows 10" \
    --architecture x86_64

  # Create an image from a YAML or JSON file
  zstack-cli create image -f image-spec.yaml

  # Create an image from a YAML or JSON file with a different name
  zstack-cli create image override-name -f image-spec.yaml

  zstack-cli create image [NAME] [flags]

      --architecture string    CPU architecture (x86_64, aarch64, mips64el) (default "x86_64")
